summary: YPF filed a 6-K reporting the closing of two related transactions: (i) Pluspetrol transferred its entire interest in the Southern Hub (Meseta Buena Esperanza, Aguada Villanueva, Las Tacanas) to YPF, giving YPF 100% interest; and (ii) the parties amended a prior January 22 agreement regarding Pluspetrol's acquisition of either a 20% direct interest in UTE Agreements or 44.44% of Vaca Muerta Inversiones shares. No financial terms, premiums, or board recommendations were disclosed. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of an already-closed asset swap/transfer, not a special situation.
